description: This file defines the class 'RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy', which is a strategy for filtering silo placement based on specific metadata keys in Orleans runtime. It includes constructors, initialization, and a method to get additional grain properties related to metadata keys.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: A placement filter strategy that filters silos based on specified metadata keys.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with specified metadata keys and order.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the filter with grain properties, extracting metadata keys.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Returns additional grain properties, specifically the metadata keys joined into a string.
